utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep—it’s now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. If you want, I can also check what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, please check what’s still left to do.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can check what’s still needed for the repair drive—just a sec. If you already know of any tools or volunteers, I can add that too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell — I’m keeping the supply list updated for the Sunday repair drive at the community center. If you can check on tools or volunteers, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can check on both—what tools are still needed, and do you want me to ask around for volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Nell—please ask around for volunteers, and I’ll send you the current tools list in a moment.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Uli — sorting and unloading would be a big help. We’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, so that’s where we’ll meet.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, Sunday at the community center works. I can help with sorting and unloading for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Uli — that’ll help a lot. We’ll keep it short and start sorting and unloading at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. I’ll send the exact meeting spot and any updates soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa — just send me the meeting spot when you have it, and I’ll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Sam — I’ll send the exact meeting spot as soon as I confirm it. Thanks again for being willing to help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s on Sunday at 4:30 at the community center on Maple Street. If you can, bring any spare tools or repair items you have.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—Sunday at 4:30 at the community center on Maple Street. Do you still need any more tools or volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, a few more volunteers would help, and any extra tools are welcome too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rey — I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center now. If they still need simple help, I’ll let folks know you’re available.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. Just let me know if anything simple still needs doing, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll keep everyone posted and send anyone your way if they can use a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes — we still need a few more volunteers, and any extra tools would help too. It’s Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks for the reminder — Sunday at the community center, got it. I’ll see if I can bring a couple tools and maybe help out too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be a big help, Oren. I’ll keep the plan simple: Sunday at the community center, and we can use every extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes—any extra tools or a few more volunteers would still help. It’s now on Sunday at the community center, and 4:30 is still the plan.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s Sunday at the community center at 4:30 now, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that’s right—Sunday at the community center at 4:30.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s on Sunday now at the community center, and we still need folks to keep bringing in tools and supplies. I can help coordinate whatever’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — Sunday at the community center. Thanks, Gus; I can help round up a few more tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Noah — I appreciate that. I’ll keep an eye on what’s still missing, and we can compare notes before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what the repair drive needs first? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, and we mainly need help sorting the fixable items first. If you can, please send along the details and we’ll keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll keep the fixable items sorted first and send over the details I have.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. If you find those tools, bring a few along when you come.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — Sunday at the community center. I’ll see if I can bring a couple tools when I swing by, even if I’m running late.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — just come when you can, and those tools would definitely help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, still around 4:30 after school pickup. We’ve already got a nice turnout, but I can still use a few extra tools if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Sunday at the community center around 4:30. I can bring a few extra tools by, just tell me what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great — screwdrivers, a hammer, and maybe a drill if you’ve got one. Thanks, Bo!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — it’s now on Sunday at the community center. I’ll let you know if we still need more tools or extra volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—just let me know if you need anything else, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Sam — I appreciate it. I’ll keep you posted if we need extra hands or tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Noah — it’s Sunday at 4:30, at the community center on Maple Street. If you can, bring any repair tools or spare parts you have.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — Sunday at 4:30 at the community center on Maple Street. I’ll bring what tools and spare parts I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks, Noah. See you Sunday at 4:30 at the community center on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Pia — it’s on Sunday now at the community center. We could still use a few more volunteers if you know anyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, Sunday at the community center makes more sense. I’ll see if I can ask around for a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Pia — I really appreciate it. If anyone can help with tools too, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still getting the details second-hand—what time and place is the repair drive, Rosa?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s on Sunday at 4:30 at the community center. I’m making sure everyone knows, and I can check on tools or volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa—that helps. What tools or volunteers still need to be checked on?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I heard it’s moved to Sunday at the community center now. I’ll keep an ear out for a spare drill or extra extension cords too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, that helps. If you hear about any extra extension cords, let me know—I can bring them by Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing—I’ll pass along any word on extension cords. See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks — it’s now Sunday at the community center, and we could still use a few more tools and volunteers if you can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Sunday at the community center. I’ll spread the word about tools and volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Bo — I really appreciate it. If anyone can bring a drill, hammer, or just an extra pair of hands, send them our way!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The biggest need is probably setup at the community center on Sunday—tables, supplies, and a hand directing people in. I can help a little, but I’ll need to keep it brief.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday at the community center works. Tables and supplies first, and if you can, help direct people in too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do that for a bit on Sunday. Just let me know what time to be there at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, I’ll call first and head over to the community center on Sunday. Thanks for the heads-up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s right — Sunday at the community center. Thanks for checking in, Dane!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll give them a quick call before I head over Sunday. Thanks, Tess.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center, and we still need folks to help sort and carry drop-offs. Thanks for spreading the word, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik. Sunday at the community center works much better — I’ll keep track of supplies and let folks know we still need help sorting and carrying drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks, Cleo — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep repeating that it’s Sunday at the community center and we still need help sorting and carrying drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you confirm the repair drive is still Sunday at the community center, and tell me what small items they need most?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, it’s Sunday at the community center. They still need small tools and a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — I’ll bring some small tools and see if I can help volunteer.
